name: Frame Out
source:
Main character attends film research club that's filled only with ghost members. One day girl knocks at the club's door in hope of joining. She is very interested in shooting a film, but what kind of film is it possible to make with just one male and one female?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-april-2004-realize.html]vndbreview[/url]]
